target: CPCB-method-derived citywide daily AQI estimate (not an official CPCB bulletin value)
target_definition: Daily mean of eligible hourly citywide station AQI estimates reconstructed from pollutant concentrations with CPCB-style breakpoints and data sufficiency rules.
source_time_zone: Source data dictionary describes recent 15-minute pollutant timestamps as UTC; recent data was converted to Asia/Kolkata before daily aggregation.
limitations: Recent target is a derived estimate, not an official CPCB daily bulletin AQI.
Reported historical hourly AQI covers 2017-2023, while recent pollutant files cover 2024-2025; the source archive has no same-time overlap for direct independent hourly validation.
Current archive ends 2025-12-31; predictions in 2026 require refreshed compatible input history.
Use only input daily features with the same units and aggregation as training.
day3_policy: Persistence fallback; the fitted 3-day experimental model is not included in the inference bundle because it did not beat persistence on the final test.
